answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization aims at generating short summaries that capture the essentials of a long document.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE-L to evaluate our generated summaries against the reference. ... To evaluate factuality, there have been many proposed automatic metrics. We report FactCC and DEP-Entail, as they are highly correlated with human judgment of factuality.

answer_4.quote: To confirm our observation, we conduct human evaluation asking Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to judge the factuality and informativeness of the summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were prompted to judge factuality (consistency with the document) and informativeness (covering main points) using specific examples and criteria.
